verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a GPU marketplace that ships a CLI, SDK and API, but nothing in the evidence documents a telemetry or usage-tracking setting or an opt-out mechanism. Account-free price feeds and email-less fingerprint signup are adjacent privacy features, not a way to opt out of usage tracking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
